title: THE TITLE FILLS THE SCREEN
why: His order of 2026-10-12 (#50): make the menus look like a AAA game, checked in pictures. The Undercroft walking behind the title is smaller than the screen, so it showed as a lighter rectangle with dark bands round it, like a letterboxed screenshot. The title glass now softly blurs it and fades to black at every edge, so the menu sits on the whole screen.
now: The title backdrop is soft and fades to black at the edges, with no rectangle showing.
